arabic_text: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
translation_text: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get what they intended.

arabic_text: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
translation_text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic_text: إِنَّ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ أَحْسَنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا
translation_text: The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.

arabic_text: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ
translation_text: Cleanliness is half of faith.

arabic_text: يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا
translation_text: Make things easy for people and do not make them difficult, bring good tidings and do not repel them.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
translation_text: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

arabic_text: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
translation_text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.

arabic_text: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
translation_text: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands Muslims are safe.

arabic_text: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى
translation_text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand (the giving hand is better than the receiving hand).

arabic_text: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ
translation_text: Look at those who are beneath you and do not look at those who are above you, for it is more suitable that you do not underestimate the blessings of Allah.

arabic_text: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation_text: Whoever treads a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.

arabic_text: لاَ تَغْضَبْ
translation_text: Do not get angry.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
translation_text: The strong person is not the one who can wrestle others down; the strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.

arabic_text: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ
translation_text: Avoid suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech.

arabic_text: اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ
translation_text: Save yourself from the Hellfire, even if it is with half a date given in charity.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
translation_text: Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

arabic_text: مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَضَاءَ لَهُ مِنَ النُّورِ مَا بَيْنَ الْجُمُعَتَيْنِ
translation_text: Whoever reads Sura Al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays.

arabic_text: الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا
translation_text: The believer to another believer is like a building whose different parts support each other.

arabic_text: إِذَا جَاءَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِّحَتْ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ
translation_text: When Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened.

arabic_text: الصِّيَامُ جُنَّةٌ فَلاَ يَرْفُثْ وَلاَ يَجْهَلْ
translation_text: Fasting is a shield; so when one of you is fasting he should not use foul language or raise his voice.

arabic_text: مَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
translation_text: Whoever stands in prayer during Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, all his previous sins will be forgiven.

arabic_text: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
translation_text: The best of you is the one who learns the Quran and teaches it.

arabic_text: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ
translation_text: Supplication is worship itself.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا
translation_text: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him tenfold.

arabic_text: لاَ يَزَالُ لِسَانُكَ رَطْبًا مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
translation_text: Keep your tongue moist with the remembrance of Allah.

arabic_text: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ مَثَلُ الْحَيِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
translation_text: The difference between the one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not is like the difference between the living and the dead.

arabic_text: سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لاَ ظِلَّ إِلاَّ ظِلُّهُ
translation_text: Seven people whom Allah will shade on the Day when there is no shade but His: a just ruler...

arabic_text: مَنْ يَضْمَنُ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ
translation_text: Whoever guards his tongue and his private parts, I guarantee him Paradise.

arabic_text: نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ
translation_text: Two blessings which many people lose: health and free time.

arabic_text: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
translation_text: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler along a path.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
translation_text: Richness does not lie in an abundance of worldly goods, but richness is the richness of the soul.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
translation_text: Allah has written mercy for everything.

arabic_text: لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ
translation_text: He who cuts off family ties will not enter Paradise.

arabic_text: الرَّاحِمُونَ يَرْحَمُهُمُ الرَّحْمَنُ، ارْحَمُوا مَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ يَرْحَمْكُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ
translation_text: The merciful are shown mercy by the All-Merciful. Show mercy to those on earth, and He who is in the heavens will show mercy to you.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ سَهْلاً هَيِّنًا لَيِّنًا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ
translation_text: Whoever is easy-going, gentle, and flexible, Allah makes him forbidden for the Fire.

arabic_text: وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
translation_text: A good word is charity.

arabic_text: كُلُّ سُلاَمَى مِنَ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِ صَدَقَةٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَطْلُعُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ
translation_text: Every joint of a person owes charity every day the sun rises.

arabic_text: الْحَيَاءُ لاَ يَأْتِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ
translation_text: Modesty brings nothing but good.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا الصَّبْرُ عِنْدَ الصَّدْمَةِ الأُولَى
translation_text: Patience is at the first stroke of a calamity.

arabic_text: أَفْضَلُ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ
translation_text: The best of prayer after the obligatory prayers is the night prayer (Tahajjud).

arabic_text: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ، وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا، وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
translation_text: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed to erase it, and treat people with good character.

arabic_text: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
translation_text: The most complete of believers in faith are those with the best character.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ، وَيُعْطِي عَلَى الرِّفْقِ مَا لاَ يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ
translation_text: Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness, and He grants for gentleness what He does not grant for harshness.

arabic_text: لاَ ضَرَرَ وَلاَ ضِرَارَ
translation_text: There is no harm and no reciprocation of harm in Islam.

arabic_text: السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
translation_text: Taking care of a widow and a poor person is like striving in the cause of Allah.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
translation_text: Riches are not from having many goods, but true richness is contentment of the heart.

arabic_text: مَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
translation_text: Whoever conceals the faults of a Muslim, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the Next.

arabic_text: لاَ يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ وَاحِدٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
translation_text: A believer does not get stung from the same hole twice.

arabic_text: ادْعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَنْتُمْ مُوقِنُونَ بِالإِجَابَةِ
translation_text: Make supplication to Allah while you are certain of an answer.

arabic_text: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى
translation_text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.

arabic_text: احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجَزْ
translation_text: Strive for that which benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not lose heart.

arabic_text: التَّقْوَى هَاهُنَا
translation_text: Taqwa (God-consciousness) is right here — and he pointed to his chest three times.

arabic_text: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ
translation_text: Charity does not decrease wealth.

arabic_text: وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا
translation_text: No slave forgives another except that Allah increases his honor.

arabic_text: وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ
translation_text: No one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status.

arabic_text: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ
translation_text: Allah will help His servant as long as the servant is helping his brother.

arabic_text: الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
translation_text: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation_text: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.

arabic_text: وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ
translation_text: Lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire.

arabic_text: لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا
translation_text: Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices, do not hate one another, do not turn away from one another.

arabic_text: وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا
translation_text: Be servants of Allah, brothers to one another.

arabic_text: الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يَخْذُلُهُ وَلاَ يَكْذِبُهُ وَلاَ يَحْقِرُهُ
translation_text: A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim: he does not oppress him, nor forsake him, nor lie to him, nor despise him.

arabic_text: كُلُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَامٌ دَمُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعِرْضُهُ
translation_text: All of a Muslim is sacred to another Muslim: his blood, his property, and his honor.

arabic_text: قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ
translation_text: Say: I believe in Allah, and then remain steadfast.

arabic_text: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
translation_text: Religion is sincerity.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الْحَلاَلَ بَيِّنٌ وَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ
translation_text: What is lawful is clear and what is unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful matters.

arabic_text: إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَدَعَ شَيْئًا لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ أَبْدَلَكَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْهُ
translation_text: Whoever leaves something for the sake of Allah, Allah will replace it with something better.

arabic_text: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلأُ الْمِيزَانَ
translation_text: Purity is half of faith, and Al-Hamdulillah fills the scale.

arabic_text: وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ تَمْلآنِ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ
translation_text: SubhanAllah and Al-Hamdulillah fill what is between heaven and earth.

arabic_text: وَالصَّلاَةُ نُورٌ وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ
translation_text: Prayer is light, charity is proof, and patience is illumination.

arabic_text: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
translation_text: He who specifies a path to walk in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.

arabic_text: إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ: صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
translation_text: When a man dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for him.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
translation_text: Allah does not look at your bodies or your appearances, but He looks at your hearts.

arabic_text: أَعْظَمُ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
translation_text: Surah Al-Fatihah is the greatest Surah in the Quran.

arabic_text: اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لأَصْحَابِهِ
translation_text: Recite the Quran, for it will come on the Day of Resurrection as an intercessor for its companions.

arabic_text: رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا
translation_text: The two Rak'ahs before the Fajr prayer are better than this world and everything in it.

arabic_text: أَقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ
translation_text: The closest a servant comes to his Lord is while he is in prostration (Sujood), so increase your supplications.

arabic_text: حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى
translation_text: Perform your prayers regularly, for prayer forbids immorality and wrongdoing.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ
translation_text: Whoever prays Fajr is under the protection of Allah.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَامَ نِصْفَ اللَّيْلِ وَمَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَكَأَنَّمَا صَلَّى اللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ
translation_text: Whoever prays Isha in congregation, it is as if he prayed half the night; and whoever prays Fajr in congregation, it is as if he prayed the whole night.

arabic_text: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ مَا لَمْ تُغْشَ الْكَبَائِرُ
translation_text: The five daily prayers and Friday prayer to the next Friday prayer are an expiation for whatever sins occur between them, so long as major sins are avoided.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ
translation_text: Verily, Allah is Beautiful and He loves beauty.

arabic_text: الْكِبْرُ بَطَرُ الْحَقِّ وَغَمْطُ النَّاسِ
translation_text: Pride is disdaining the truth and scorning people.

arabic_text: مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
translation_text: Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah accepts his repentance.

arabic_text: لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
translation_text: Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than one of you who finds his lost camel in a barren desert.

arabic_text: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي
translation_text: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks I am, and I am with him when he remembers Me.

arabic_text: وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَيَّ بِشِبْرٍ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا
translation_text: If he comes close to Me a hand-span, I come close to him an arm-length; if he comes walking, I come running.

arabic_text: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ
translation_text: Look at those who are lower than you, and do not look at those who are higher than you.

arabic_text: مَنْ سَنَّ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً فَلَهُ أَجْرُهَا وَأَجْرُ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ
translation_text: Whoever introduces a good practice in Islam will have its reward and the reward of those who act upon it after him.

arabic_text: مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ
translation_text: Whoever calls to guidance will have a reward similar to the rewards of those who follow him.

arabic_text: خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ
translation_text: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday.

arabic_text: فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ
translation_text: On Friday there is an hour in which no Muslim servant stands in prayer asking Allah for good except that He gives it to him.

arabic_text: صِيَامُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ أَحْتَسِبُ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ السَّنَةَ الَّتِي قَبْلَهُ وَالسَّنَةَ الَّتِي بَعْدَهُ
translation_text: Fast the day of Ashura, for I hope that Allah will expiate the sins of the year before it.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتًّا مِنْ شَوَّالٍ كَانَ كَصِيَامِ الدَّهْرِ
translation_text: Whoever fasts Ramadan and then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he fasted for a lifetime.

arabic_text: التَّسَحُّرُ بَرَكَةٌ فَلاَ تَدَعُوهُ
translation_text: Suhoor is a blessed meal, so do not omit it even if one of you takes a sip of water.

arabic_text: لاَ يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّلُوا الْفِطْرَ
translation_text: The people will continue to be upon good as long as they hasten to break their fast.

arabic_text: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ صَائِمًا فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى تَمْرٍ فَإِنَّهُ بَرَكَةٌ
translation_text: When one of you breaks his fast, let him break it with dates, for they are blessed.

arabic_text: بَدَأَ الإِسْلاَمُ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ كَمَا بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا فَطُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ
translation_text: Islam began as something strange and will return to being strange as it began, so glad tidings to the strangers.

arabic_text: لاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا
translation_text: Do not be envious of one another, do not hate one another, and be brothers, O servants of Allah.

arabic_text: وَالصَّدَقَةُ تُطْفِئُ الْخَطِيئَةَ كَمَا يُطْفِئُ الْمَاءُ النَّارَ
translation_text: Charity erases sins just as water extinguishes fire.

arabic_text: مَا نَحَلَ وَالِدٌ وَلَدًا مِنْ نَحْلٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أدَبٍ حَسَنٍ
translation_text: There is no gift a parent can give a child better than good manners and moral training.

arabic_text: مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي خُرْفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ
translation_text: He who visits a sick person is in the gardens of Paradise until he returns.

arabic_text: جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ جُزْءًا وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا
translation_text: Allah has divided mercy into one hundred parts: He kept ninety-nine parts with Him and sent down one part to earth.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
translation_text: Say O Allah, You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.

arabic_text: وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ
translation_text: Patience is a light that illuminates the path of life.

arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
translation_text: When one of you wakes up from sleep, he should say: Praise be to Allah who restored to me my soul and gave me health.

arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
translation_text: Whoever says in the evening: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm...

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
translation_text: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Next.

arabic_text: إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ
translation_text: When you go to your bed, recite Ayat al-Kursi, for a guardian from Allah will remain with you.

arabic_text: مَنْ قَرَأَ بِالآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ
translation_text: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.

arabic_text: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الأُتْرُجَّةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ
translation_text: The believer who recites the Quran is like a citrus fruit: its fragrance is sweet and its taste is sweet.

arabic_text: مَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ حَسَنَةً
translation_text: Whoever seeks forgiveness for the believing men and believing women, Allah records a good deed for him for every believer.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الْعُلَمَاءَ وَرَثَةُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ
translation_text: The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets.

arabic_text: إِنَّ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ لَتَضَعُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ رِضًا بِمَا يَصْنَعُ
translation_text: Angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge out of pleasure for what he does.

arabic_text: دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ
translation_text: When a person supplicates for his brother in secret, the angel says: Amen, and for you the same.

arabic_text: لاَ يُرَدُّ الدُّعَاءُ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ
translation_text: Supplication is not rejected between the Adhan and the Iqamah.

arabic_text: أَكْثِرُوا عَلَيَّ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعْرُوضَةٌ عَلَيَّ
translation_text: Increase your sending of blessings upon me on Friday, for your blessings are presented to me.

arabic_text: تُعْرَضُ الأَعْمَالُ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ يُعْرَضَ عَمَلِي وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ
translation_text: The best day to perform voluntary fasts is Monday and Thursday.

arabic_text: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
translation_text: When any of you eats food, let him mention the name of Allah.

arabic_text: كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ وَاشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِكَ
translation_text: Eat with your right hand and drink with your right hand.

arabic_text: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ بَيْنَكُمْ تَحَابُّوا
translation_text: Greeting people with Salam is a means to spread love among believers.

arabic_text: تَهَادَوْا تَحَابُّوا
translation_text: Give gifts to one another, and you will love one another.

arabic_text: الْحَيَاءُ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ
translation_text: Modesty is part of faith.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
translation_text: Allah loves gentle manners in all things.

arabic_text: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْحَسَدَ فَإِنَّ الْحَسَدَ يَأْكُلُ الْحَسَنَاتِ كَمَا تَأْكُلُ النَّارُ الْحَطَبَ
translation_text: Do not envy one another; envy consumes good deeds as fire consumes wood.

arabic_text: الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ
translation_text: Consultation brings wisdom and blessing.

arabic_text: التَّاجِرُ الصَّدُوقُ الأَمِينُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ
translation_text: The truthful merchant will be gathered with the Prophets, the truthful, and the martyrs.

arabic_text: لاَ يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لاَ يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
translation_text: He who is not grateful to people is not grateful to Allah.

arabic_text: مَنْ أَعَانَ صَانِعًا أَوْ صَنَعَ لأَخْرَقَ كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرٌ
translation_text: Whoever assists a worker or acts for one who cannot work will have great reward.

arabic_text: إِخْلاَصُ النِّيَّةِ يُعَظِّمُ الْعَمَلَ الصَّغِيرَ
translation_text: Sincerity in intention elevates a small action.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقْبَلُ تَوْبَةَ الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ
translation_text: Tawbah (repentance) is open as long as the soul has not reached the throat.

arabic_text: الصَّبْرُ نِصْفُ الإِيمَانِ وَالشُّكْرُ نِصْفُهُ الآخَرُ
translation_text: Patience is half of faith, and gratitude is the other half.

arabic_text: عَجَبًا لأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
translation_text: Wonderful is the affair of the believer, for there is good for him in every matter.

arabic_text: إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ
translation_text: If good touches him, he gives thanks and it is good for him; if hardship touches him, he endures with patience and it is good for him.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَمَتَ نَجَا
translation_text: Guarding the tongue leads to safety.

arabic_text: أَفْشُوا السَّلاَمَ كَيْ تَحَابُّوا
translation_text: Spreading peace (Salam) creates love in the community.

arabic_text: أَطْعِمُوا الْجَائِعَ وَعُودُوا الْمَرِيضَ وَفُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ
translation_text: Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
translation_text: Honor your guests and maintain good relations with your neighbors.

arabic_text: مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ
translation_text: A neighbor has rights over his neighbor until he thinks he will inherit from him.

arabic_text: الْجَنَّةُ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِ الأُمَّهَاتِ
translation_text: Paradise lies under the feet of mothers.

arabic_text: رِضَى الرَّبِّ فِي رِضَى الْوَالِدَيْنِ
translation_text: Pleasure of the Lord lies in the pleasure of the parents.

arabic_text: أَيُُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ كَسَا مُسْلِمًا ثَوْبًا عَلَى عُرْيٍ كَسَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ خُضْرِ الْجَنَّةِ
translation_text: Whoever satisfies a hungry stomach will be clothed by Allah with green robes of Paradise.

arabic_text: لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ
translation_text: Do not consider any good deed insignificant, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

arabic_text: تَبَسُُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ صَدَقَةٌ
translation_text: A smile to your brother is an act of charity.

arabic_text: وَيُمِيطُ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةٌ
translation_text: Remove harm from the road, for it is charity.

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ
translation_text: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas is equivalent to one third of the Quran.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ وَقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ تَكْفِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
translation_text: Reciting Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas protects from all evil.

arabic_text: سَلاَمَةُ الصَّدْرِ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ السُّنَنِ
translation_text: Keep your heart clean from hatred and malice towards anyone.

arabic_text: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ مَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُ
translation_text: The best of people is the one who lives long and improves his deeds.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
translation_text: O Allah, help me remember You, thank You, and worship You in the best manner.

arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ
translation_text: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence.

arabic_text: لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ
translation_text: Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.

arabic_text: وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
translation_text: His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not.

arabic_text: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation_text: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation_text: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
translation_text: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

arabic_text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translation_text: Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا
translation_text: Our Lord, do not impose upon us a burden like that which You imposed on those before us.

arabic_text: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
translation_text: You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help.

arabic_text: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
translation_text: Guide us to the straight path.

arabic_text: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
translation_text: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

arabic_text: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ
translation_text: And He found you lost and guided you.

arabic_text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation_text: So indeed, with hardship will be ease. Indeed, with hardship will be ease.

arabic_text: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation_text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.

arabic_text: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translation_text: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation_text: Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

arabic_text: وَمَنْ يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation_text: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

arabic_text: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
translation_text: And He will provide for him from where he does not expect.

arabic_text: لَئِنْ شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
translation_text: If you are grateful, I will surely increase your favor.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ مُحْسِنُونَ
translation_text: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

arabic_text: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ الْيَقِينُ
translation_text: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).

arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
translation_text: Say: He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

arabic_text: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
translation_text: He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
translation_text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created.

arabic_text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
translation_text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind.

arabic_text: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا
translation_text: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you.

arabic_text: وَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا
translation_text: And speak to people good words.

arabic_text: وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
translation_text: Establish prayer and give Zakah and bow with those who bow.

arabic_text: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
translation_text: Decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous.

arabic_text: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِلنَّاسِ
translation_text: The month of Ramadan [is that] in which was revealed the Quran, a guidance for the people.

arabic_text: إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ
translation_text: Indeed, We sent the Quran down during the Night of Decree.

arabic_text: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
translation_text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

arabic_text: وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا
translation_text: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.

arabic_text: إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ
translation_text: Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.

arabic_text: وَاخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ الذُّلِّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقُلْ رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
translation_text: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

arabic_text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
translation_text: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.

arabic_text: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
translation_text: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic_text: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
translation_text: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

arabic_text: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation_text: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
translation_text: Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who have believed, ask Allah to confer blessing upon him and ask Him to grant him peace.
